CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schedule_exceptions (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    doctor_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES doctors(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    exception_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unavailable'
        CHECK (exception_type IN ('unavailable')),

    starts_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ends_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,

    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assistant',
    created_by TEXT,

    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    CHECK (ends_at > starts_at)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_schedule_exceptions_doctor_time
    ON schedule_exceptions (
        doctor_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at
    )
    WHERE is_active = TRUE;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM pg_constraint
        WHERE conname = 'no_overlapping_active_doctor_blocks'
    ) THEN
        ALTER TABLE schedule_exceptions
            ADD CONSTRAINT no_overlapping_active_doctor_blocks
            EXCLUDE USING gist (
                doctor_id WITH =,
                tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)') WITH &&
            )
            WHERE (
                is_active = TRUE
                AND exception_type = 'unavailable'
            );
    END IF;
END
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_appointment_in_blocked_time()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
       AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM schedule_exceptions se
            WHERE se.doctor_id = NEW.doctor_id
              AND se.is_active = TRUE
              AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'
              AND se.starts_at < NEW.ends_at
              AND se.ends_at > NEW.starts_at
       )
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            USING
                ERRCODE = 'P0001',
                MESSAGE = 'appointment_time_blocked_by_schedule_exception';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_appointment_in_blocked_time
    ON appointments;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_appointment_in_blocked_time
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF
    doctor_id,
    starts_at,
    ends_at,
    status
ON appointments
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_appointment_in_blocked_time();

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'migration_completed' AS result,
    'ساختار استثناهای برنامه پزشک و کنترل مرکزی رزرو ایجاد شد.' AS message;

## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Workflow جدول `schedule_exceptions` را می‌سازد و یک کنترل مرکزی روی جدول appointments قرار می‌دهد تا هیچ نوبت فعال داخل بازه مسدودشده ثبت یا جابه‌جا نشود.

پس از اجرای موفق، Workflow را غیرفعال نگه دار.
